understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate through every level and activate all goal cells by stepping onto each one while the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation exactly matched the goal's requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move consumed one stamina, and reaching zero stamina cost a life before resetting stamina. Walls blocked movement, and blocked_directions had to be checked before every move. Shape, color, and rotation modifier tiles changed the corresponding piece attributes: shape cycled through six values, color followed orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation advanced clockwise through 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees. A goal only completed when all three attributes matched simultaneously. Careful route planning was necessary because wasted or blocked moves consumed stamina and could cause loss of lives.
